# Starlite Lounge

> Starlite Lounge is a neighborhood bar and local music venue on W Olive Ave in Glendale, AZ. Live bands, affordable drinks, and food to eat in or take out.

- Type: Sports Bar
- Address: 4346 W Olive Ave, Glendale, AZ 85302, USA
- Phone: (623) 934-9910
- Website: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/starlite-lounge/
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=8191016853647656525&g_mp=Cidnb29nbGUubWFwcy5wbGFjZXMudjEuUGxhY2VzLlNlYXJjaFRleHQQAhgEIAA
- Google rating: 4.3 from 638 reviews

## About
Starlite Lounge is a bar on W Olive Ave in Glendale. A reviewer called it a very cool dive bar with a dark, yet cozy ambience, and that is a fair way to picture the place.
We are known around here for bands and good sound. A band that played here and a reviewer both praised our sound man. Between sets, the bartenders, waitresses and cooks keep things friendly and moving.
We hold a 4.3 rating from 638 Google reviews. Stop by and see who is playing.

## Services
- Concerts and bands: Bands play on our stage, including heavy metal shows.
- Drinks: Drinks at affordable prices, served by friendly bartenders and waitresses.
- Food, dine-in or take-out: Our cooks keep the kitchen going, so you can eat here or take your order to go.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: Yes. On Sunday we are open from 6:00 AM to 2:00 AM.

Q: Do you serve food?
A: Yes. You can eat in or take your food to go.

Q: Do you have concerts?
A: Yes. Bands play here, and a reviewer came in for a heavy metal concert.

## What customers say
- "Our band The DreamSeekers have played there and it was a super awesome experience. The sound was the best I've ever heard!!! We drive an hour to come and play at starlite but with the professional sound system and thanks to the magic of their sound man Paul its definitely worth it. They are starting a open mic and with Billy Wilson at the helm it's going to be epic!!! The DreamSeekers will definitely be there! 🎸🎙️🤘" (bonnie turner, 5/5)
- "Very cool dive bar with a dark, yet cozy ambience. We went and saw a heavy metal concert which was so fun, bands were GREAT!  My favorite was the opening act, Writing Off Tomorrow and I left with some cool merch including a CD and some homemade hot sauce.  Drink prices were very reasonable and the service was friendly. I didn’t eat any food, but what I saw coming out looked good. Loved it!" (Bella Enriquez, 5/5)
- "Great energy here! Came to the hard luck show when they played here and the lead singer Billy was amazing, the band was great and service was excellent. Highly recommend coming here to let your hair down and have some fun! Fantastic people. My friends and i will be coming back again very soon" (Mekenna Wilson, 5/5)
- "Outstanding bands, bartenders & waitresses, management, dorman, sound & lights guy, and cooks all provide a safe, friendly, welcoming environment, and excellent service. Don't forget the great food., Dine-in or take-out." (Rhonda O'Hara, 5/5)
